description: This file provides a script to query capabilities of the cuttlefish-* packages, allowing users to check support for specific functionalities like 'capability_check', 'qemu_cli', and 'vsock'. It includes a main function that outputs all capabilities or exits with an error if queried capabilities are unsupported.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that handles command-line arguments to query or list capabilities.
